Subject to a maximum of ₹10,00,000/- per annum, less applicable taxes
Ministry of External Affairs, New Delhi

content_sections.heading: About the Position
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Administration Division of the Ministry of External Affairs from Jawaharlal Nehru Bhawan, New Delhi, dated 16 November 2026. The selected Consultant will work as Legal Consultant in the DPA-III Division of MEA. The engagement is described as strictly contractual.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice lists these essential criteria: Applicant should be an Indian National. Applicants must have an LLB Degree from a recognized university in India or abroad. Age criteria 35-60 years. The notice prints no age cut-off date and no age relaxation. Applicant should possess fluency in English. Applicant should be well versed with the use of computer, internet etc. Extra credit will be given for experience of work in a reputed law firm in the area of arbitration and contract law. Desirable criteria: Minimum 5 years of experience in the field. Previous experience of work relating to legal contractual matters, arbitration cases and International Law in Government of India will be given weightage. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility wording.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The remuneration package will be commensurate with the experience and profile of the selected candidate, subject to a maximum of ₹10,00,000/- (Rupees Ten Lakh only) per annum and deduction of applicable taxes. The fee is paid in Indian Rupees and, once fixed, remains unchanged during the term of engagement. The contract is initially for one year and can be extended depending on assessment of performance, mutual willingness and requirement. It may be terminated on one month's notice from either side, or on payment of one month's pay in lieu. Unauthorized absence may lead to termination. The engagement is strictly contractual and gives no Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Attendance Treatment, Seniority, Promotion or other benefits of regular employees. No HRA is admissible. The engagement is full time. Normal working hours are 0900 to 1730 hrs, subject to change. Saturdays and Sundays are weekend off. No extra allowance is admissible for work beyond office hours or on closed holidays. Paid leave may be allowed at 1.5 days for each completed month of service. Leave cannot be claimed as a matter of right and is not allowed for more than 10 days at a time. Leave encashment is not permissible, and unspent leave lapses on commencement of the notice period. Absence beyond entitled leave leads to a proportionate deduction from the consolidated fee. If travel is required as part of duties, the Ministry will take care of travel, accommodation and per-diem costs as per its guidelines.

content_sections.heading: MEA Consultant (Legal) Job Description
content_sections.text: The duties entail, but are not limited to, the following: Assisting the Division on all legal and contractual matters, drafting notices and legal replies and supporting arbitration cases of the Division, and coordinating with the lawyers and arbitrators. Filing replies based on the contractual provisions, contract replies having legal repercussions etc. Interpreting and advising on legal matters related to Law of Contracts, handling dispute resolutions. Regular monitoring and follow up of specific legal issues entrusted to him/her. Analyzing legal issues and recommending a course of action in the legal issues assigned. Attending court hearings, liaising with Government lawyers and preparing legal briefs. Undertaking research on specific legal issues. Maintaining a status report of all ongoing Court Cases and tracking the dates of next hearing to alert the officers concerned. Processing matters related to payment of professional fees to Central Govt. Counsel as admissible. Training the regular staff of the Ministry to transfer knowledge and skills during the period of Consultancy. Any other legal matter assigned by the Head of Division.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MEA Consultant (Legal)
content_sections.text: Fill in the application in the proforma at Annexure I (for Indian Nationals only). It asks for personal details, educational qualifications, mobile number, email ID, address for communication, employment details, courses attended, languages known, previous consultancy, additional information and remarks. A passport size photo is pasted on it and it is signed and dated. Attach documents and certificates supporting educational qualifications and experience in Govt. service. Offline mode: send by registered post in an envelope labelled "Application for the position of Consultant (Legal) in DPA-III Division of Ministry of External Affairs" to Under Secretary (PF&PG), Ministry of External Affairs, Room No. 4071, Jawaharlal Nehru Bhawan, 23-D, Janpath, New Delhi-110011. Email mode: send the application with supporting documents to [email protected] , with the subject clearly mentioning the name of the candidate and the position applied for. The notice allows either mode. Applications received after the closing date, without the prescribed documents, incomplete or not in the Annexure I proforma are liable to be rejected, and no correspondence will be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: MEA will review the applications and shortlist candidates for interview. Shortlisted candidates will be intimated by email, and the date, time and venue of the interview will be conveyed to the email address given in the application. The final selection will be based on performance at the interview, and the decision of the Government regarding selection is final. Applicants must make their own arrangements to reach the place of interview, and no TA/DA is payable by the Ministry for attending it. The selected person must enter into a contract with the Ministry in a prescribed format from the actual date of engagement.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The consultant shall not accept any other professional appointment, paid or otherwise, during the term of engagement with the Ministry. The job location includes Jawaharlal Nehru Bhawan, Sushma Swaraj Bhawan, Patiala House and Kartavya Bhavan, New Delhi.
